purpose: Private (pre-IPO / pre-listing) companies to monitor for a possible public-market allocation when/if they become tradable. Not investable on the agentic book today. Not part of the public equities deploy consider set.

policy.on_owner_add: Immediately queue private position deep-dive (same phases as public position-deep-dive, adapted for pre-IPO: no public price, no deploy). Write investment/research/private/{ID}_deep_dive.md plus optional short brief. Do NOT queue public position-deep-dive until a public ticker exists. Do not leave owner names on private list without homework.
policy.on_listing_or_ipo: Promote to investment/watchlist.json (owner or agent proposal) with status monitor → immediate position-deep-dive → ready only after dive. Never auto-buy on listing day.
policy.notes: Owner 2026-08-06: private lane for future public allocations. Same deep-dive process as public stocks (owner). Still never deploy while private; no secondary authority.

entries.name: Anduril Industries
entries.last_reported_valuation: ~$61B Series H (May 2026; ~$5B raise, Thrive / a16z led — press)
entries.thesis_fit: Software-defined defense autonomy (Lattice, UAVs, C-UAS, undersea, soldier systems). Primary owner rank #1. Fits Autonomy + Robotics + AI physical-world leverage under stocks/growth when/if public. Concentration and defense-cycle risk will dominate any first-size decision.
entries.why_watch: Highest-conviction private name on the autonomy/defense stack; IPO prep language has been medium-term, not imminent. Track filing + Ohio manufacturing scale as readiness signals.
monitor_for: major DoD program wins / production rate
entries.next_catalyst: IPO process milestones or next major funding/valuation print; no confirmed IPO date as of 2026-08-06
entries.notes: Owner priority #1. Do not confuse with public defense primes. On listing → promote to public watchlist only after ticker is live; deep-dive before any size.

entries.name: Saronic Technologies
entries.last_reported_valuation: ~$9.25B Series D (Mar 2026; ~$1.75B raise, Kleiner Perkins led — press)
entries.thesis_fit: Autonomous surface vessels + shipyard scale (Port Alpha narrative) for hybrid naval fleets. Owner rank #2. Pure-play maritime autonomy under Autonomy/Robotics when/if public; execution and shipbuilding capacity are the binding risks.
entries.why_watch: High-growth maritime autonomy co in the defense-tech wave; complements Anduril land/air stack with sea domain. IPO timing unknown; private capital still deep.
entries.next_catalyst: Program awards, shipyard milestones, or funding/IPO process news; no confirmed IPO date as of 2026-08-06
entries.notes: Owner priority #2. Behind Anduril for scarce post-IPO residual capital unless relative value flips hard.

entries.name: Boom Supersonic
entries.last_reported_valuation: n/a confirmed recent mark (private; prior rounds / secondary chatter — treat as soft)
entries.thesis_fit: Dual path: (1) Overture supersonic airliner + Symphony engine heritage; (2) owner note 2026-08-06 — jet-turbine development repurposed toward data-center buildout power generation (AI/power demand). Owner rank #3. Energy + AI-power sleeve now the primary north-star link; aerospace remains secondary optionality. Still high technical / capital / execution risk vs pure-play power names.

monitor_for: Data-center / stationary power product milestones (turbine repurpose)
Power offtake, hyperscaler or infra partners, MW-scale pilots
Symphony engine milestones (flight and/or power variants)
funding round quality (up/down) — which path capital is funding
entries.next_catalyst: Power-gen / data-center turbine milestones or Overture flight/engine news; no confirmed IPO date as of 2026-08-06
